profiles.name: Aarakocra
profiles.appearance: A feathered humanoid with a bird’s beak, talons and broad wings.
tableNotes: Dive Attack. While flying, it must dive at least 30 ft. in a straight line toward the target. A following melee weapon hit adds 3 (1d6) damage.

Summon Air Elemental. Five aarakocra within 30 ft. of one another each spend their actions and movement on a dance for three consecutive turns while maintaining Concentration. An Air Elemental then appears in an open space within 60 ft. It obeys them for 1 hour or until it dies, all summoners die, or one dismisses it as a bonus action. Each summoner needs a short rest before dancing again. Aarakocra within 5 ft. of the elemental can follow it back to the Elemental Plane of Air.

profiles.name: Arcanaloth
profiles.appearance: A jackal-headed fiend with hands capable of wielding magic and a taste for fine robes.
tableNotes: On a Claws hit the target also makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) poison damage and success halves it.

profiles.name: Barlgura
profiles.appearance: A hulking, orangutan-like demon with long, muscular arms and large tusks.

profiles.name: Beholder
profiles.appearance: A floating sphere with a great central eye, a toothy mouth and a crown of smaller eyes on stalks.

profiles.name: Beholder Zombie
profiles.appearance: A decaying beholder with a torn hide, a cloudy central eye and smaller eyestalks.

profiles.name: Berserker
tableNotes: It can opt into advantage on melee attacks at the start of its turn. Attacks against it then have advantage until its following turn.

profiles.name: Blue Slaad
profiles.appearance: A tall, blue, toadlike humanoid with long claws and a powerful frame.

profiles.name: Bone Naga
profiles.appearance: The animated skeleton of a naga, with a serpentine spine and a fanged head.
tableNotes: Choose the guardian or spirit version for its spell list. The listed defenses and Bite apply to both.

profiles.name: Bugbear Chief
profiles.appearance: A broad, shaggy goblinoid with prominent ears and a heavy morningstar.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two melee attacks. The listed Javelin has different melee and thrown damage. Melee deals 10 (2d6 + 3) and a thrown hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3).
Surprise Attack. A hit against a creature the chief surprised adds 7 (2d6) damage during the first round.
Heart of Hruggek. It has Advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned and being put to sleep.

profiles.name: Bullywug
profiles.appearance: An upright frog-like humanoid with bulging eyes and webbed feet.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Spear attack in melee. The higher Spear damage applies only when wielded with two hands in melee.
It breathes air and water. It can leap 20 ft. horizontally or 10 ft. vertically without a run-up and has Advantage on Stealth checks to hide in swamps.

profiles.name: Carrion Crawler
profiles.appearance: A long segmented scavenger with numerous legs and a fringe of paralytic tentacles around its mouth.

profiles.name: Chasme
profiles.appearance: A fly-like demon with clawed limbs, translucent wings and a stabbing proboscis.
tableNotes: Proboscis reduces the target’s maximum HP by the necrotic damage dealt. The reduction ends after a long rest or with magic such as Greater Restoration. A creature whose maximum reaches zero dies.

Drone. Demons are immune. Other creatures that can hear it and start their turns within 30 ft. must make a DC 12 Constitution save or fall Unconscious for 10 minutes. Damage ends it, as does another creature spending an action to splash the victim with Holy Water. A successful save or the effect ending grants the creature immunity to this drone for 24 hours.
It resists cold, fire and lightning. It is immune to poison damage and Poisoned, has Advantage on saves against magic, and can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without a check.

profiles.name: Crawling Claw
profiles.appearance: A severed hand animated to move on its fingers.

profiles.name: Crocodile
tableNotes: A bite grapples its victim (escape DC 12). The victim is restrained, and the crocodile cannot bite a different target until the grapple ends.
It can remain underwater for up to 15 minutes without breathing.

profiles.name: Cult Fanatic
tableNotes: Multiattack is two melee attacks. Wisdom spellcasting uses DC 11 and +3 to hit. Cantrips are light, sacred flame, and thaumaturgy. It has four 1st-level slots for command, inflict wounds, and shield of faith, and three 2nd-level slots for hold person and spiritual weapon.

profiles.name: Darkmantle
tableNotes: A hit attaches it. It can attach to a Medium or smaller head, blinding the victim and blocking breathing. The victim or another creature can remove it with a DC 13 Strength check. Its darkness aura is available once per day and requires concentration.

profiles.name: Death Slaad
profiles.appearance: A slate-gray, toadlike humanoid with clawed hands. It can assume a humanoid guise.

profiles.name: Demilich
tableNotes: Howl, recharge 5–6: hearers within 30 feet make a DC 15 Constitution save or fall to 0 HP. A success still frightens them through the end of their next turn.
Life Drain: up to three creatures it can see within 10 feet make DC 19 Constitution saves or take 6d6 necrotic each. The demilich heals for the damage dealt.
It can force three failed saves to succeed daily. Against effects that deal half on a save, it takes none on success and half on failure. It has separate legendary and lair options.

profiles.name: Displacer Beast
profiles.appearance: A six-legged, panther-like predator with two barbed tentacles rising from its shoulders.

profiles.name: Drow Elite Warrior
profiles.appearance: A dark elf in studded leather who carries a shortsword and hand crossbow.

profiles.name: Drow Mage
profiles.appearance: A dark elf spellcaster with pointed ears and pale hair.

profiles.name: Empyrean

damage.type: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, radiant or thunder (choose one)

habitats: Material Plane, where some evil empyreans settle

profiles.appearance: A towering, humanlike celestial with the build and features of an idealized deity.
tableNotes: CR 23 awards 50,000 XP under the Monster Manual errata.
A creature hit by Maul must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or be Stunned through the end of the empyrean’s next turn.
Legendary actions. It has three uses per round, regained when its turn starts. After another creature’s turn it can make one attack, use Bolster, or spend two actions on Trembling Strike.
Bolster. Nonhostile creatures within 120 ft. have Advantage on checks and saves and cannot become Charmed or Frightened until the end of the empyrean’s next turn.
Trembling Strike. All other creatures on the ground within 60 ft. must pass a DC 25 Strength save or fall Prone.
Legendary Resistance (3/day) turns a failed save into a success. It has Advantage on saves against magic, and its weapon attacks are magical.

profiles.name: Faerie Dragon (Younger)
profiles.appearance: A tiny, expressive dragon with butterfly-like wings. Younger faerie dragons are red, orange or yellow.
tableNotes: Superior Invisibility. A bonus action makes the dragon Invisible until its Concentration ends. Gear it wears or carries becomes Invisible as well.

Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5–6). One creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On failure for 1 minute it cannot take reactions and rolls a d6 at each turn start. On 1–4 it spends all movement in a random direction and takes neither an action nor a bonus action. On 5–6 it stays still, and can only repeat the DC 11 Wisdom save to end the effect.

Innate spells use Charisma, DC 13, without material components. Red can cast Dancing Lights, Mage Hand and Minor Illusion once per day each. Orange adds Color Spray. Yellow adds Color Spray and Mirror Image.
It has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

profiles.name: Fire Snake
profiles.appearance: A snake-shaped young salamander with a body that radiates intense heat.

profiles.name: Flumph
profiles.appearance: A floating, jellyfish-like creature with eyestalks, trailing tendrils and a body that changes color with its emotions.
tableNotes: After a Tendrils hit, the target makes a DC 10 Constitution save at the end of each turn. Failure deals 2 (1d4) acid. Success or Lesser Restoration ends that recurring damage.

profiles.name: Fomorian
profiles.appearance: An enormous, misshapen giant with mismatched limbs and a prominent, baleful eye.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks, or one Greatclub attack and one Evil Eye.

Evil Eye. A creature it sees within 60 ft. makes a DC 14 Charisma save. Failure deals 27 (6d8) psychic and success halves it. Once per short or long rest it can use Curse of the Evil Eye to also curse the target on a failure. The curse halves speed and imposes Disadvantage on Strength- and Dexterity-based checks, saves and attacks. The target can repeat the save after each long rest to end the curse.

profiles.name: Frog
tableNotes: It has no effective attack.

profiles.name: Galeb Duhr
profiles.appearance: An animate boulder with a face and stone limbs that can tuck in and roll.
tableNotes: Roll at 30 ft., or 60 ft. downhill. After rolling straight toward a creature for at least 20 ft., a same-turn Slam hit adds 7 (2d6) bludgeoning. The target must pass a DC 16 Strength save or fall Prone.

profiles.name: Gargoyle
tableNotes: It can remain still and pass for a statue. Its Multiattack is one bite and one claw. It resists nonmagical weapon damage of the bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing types unless the weapon is adamantine.

profiles.name: Gas Spore
profiles.appearance: A floating fungus that resembles a beholder, down to its eyes and eyestalks.
tableNotes: On a Touch hit the target also makes a DC 10 Constitution save against the Death Burst disease. Creatures immune to Poisoned cannot catch it.

profiles.name: Giant Crab
tableNotes: Each claw can grapple one creature on a hit (escape DC 11). The crab can breathe air or water.

profiles.name: Giant Frog
tableNotes: Bite grapples and restrains (escape DC 11), one victim at a time. It can swallow a Small or smaller creature it is holding by hitting with a second bite. The victim takes 2d4 acid at the start of the frog’s turns and is expelled when the frog dies.
The frog can breathe in water or air. Its standing long jump is 20 feet and high jump is 10 feet.

profiles.name: Giant Hyena
tableNotes: When a melee attack reduces a creature to 0 HP on the hyena’s turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one bite as a bonus action.

profiles.name: Giant Poisonous Snake
tableNotes: Bite adds a DC 11 Constitution save against 3d6 poison, half on success.

profiles.name: Giant Rat
tableNotes: Pack Tactics gives it advantage to attack when a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 feet of the target. It has advantage on smell-based Perception.

profiles.name: Giant Wasp
tableNotes: After the piercing hit, the target makes a DC 11 Constitution save against 3d6 poison (half on success). If the poison reduces it to 0 HP, it is stable, poisoned for one hour, and paralyzed while that poison lasts.

profiles.name: Githyanki Knight
profiles.appearance: A lean, yellow-skinned humanoid with pointed ears and a silver greatsword.

profiles.name: Githyanki Warrior
profiles.appearance: A lean, yellow-skinned humanoid in half plate, armed with a greatsword.

profiles.name: Githzerai Zerth
profiles.appearance: A lean, angular humanoid with pointed ears and yellow-toned skin who fights without armor.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two magical Unarmed Strikes. Each hit deals both listed damage types.

profiles.name: Gnoll Fang of Yeenoghu
profiles.appearance: A demonic, upright hyena with a snapping jaw and long claws.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks. When Bite hits a creature, it takes 7 (2d6) poison in addition on a failed DC 12 Constitution save.
Rampage. If a melee attack on its turn drops a creature to 0 HP, it can spend a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a Bite attack.

profiles.name: Gnoll Pack Lord
profiles.appearance: An upright hyena with a powerful build, a long muzzle and a leader’s gear.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Attack twice with Glaive or Longbow and use Incite Rampage if available. Incite Rampage (Recharge 5–6) lets a creature it sees within 30 ft. make one melee attack as a reaction if it hears the call and has Rampage.

profiles.name: Goblin
tableNotes: After attacking, it can use a bonus action to Hide or Disengage.

profiles.name: Goblin Boss
profiles.appearance: A short, pointed-eared goblin armed with a scimitar and javelins.
tableNotes: The 2014 Monster Manual errata gives Javelin +2 to hit and 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

profiles.name: Gray Slaad
profiles.appearance: A gray, toadlike shapeshifter that can pass as a humanoid.

profiles.name: Green Slaad
profiles.appearance: A large, green, toadlike humanoid that can hide its shape behind a humanoid guise.
tableNotes: Multiattack. In slaad form make one Bite and two attacks with its Claw or Staff. Alternatively, use Hurl Flame twice. Only use the attacks available in its current form.
Regeneration. It regains 10 HP at the start of its turn while it has at least 1 HP. Hurl Flame ignites flammable objects that are neither held nor worn.

profiles.name: Grell
profiles.appearance: A floating, brain-shaped body with a sharp beak and ten trailing, barbed tentacles.

profiles.name: Grick Alpha
profiles.appearance: A large, rock-colored worm with a hooked beak surrounded by four barbed tentacles.

profiles.name: Half-Ogre
profiles.appearance: A broad, towering humanoid with an ogre’s build, often armed with a battleaxe.
tableNotes: Battleaxe uses the higher damage in two-handed melee.

profiles.name: Helmed Horror
profiles.appearance: A hollow suit of plate armor that moves and fights on its own.
tableNotes: Longsword uses the higher damage only in two-handed melee.

profiles.name: Hobgoblin Captain
profiles.appearance: An upright, red- or orange-skinned goblinoid in half plate, armed with a greatsword.
tableNotes: Martial Advantage. Once per turn add 10 (3d6) damage to a weapon hit if an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not Incapacitated.

Leadership (once per short or long rest). For 1 minute a nonhostile creature the hobgoblin sees within 30 ft. can add 1d4 to an attack or save if it hears and understands the command. Only one Leadership die can apply. Ends if the hobgoblin becomes Incapacitated.
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks.
The printed Greatsword deals piercing damage. The indexed version lists slashing. This profile keeps the printed damage type.

profiles.name: Hobgoblin Warlord
profiles.appearance: An armored goblinoid officer carrying a longsword, shield and javelins.
tableNotes: Martial Advantage. Once per turn add 14 (4d6) damage to a weapon hit if an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not Incapacitated.

Leadership (once per short or long rest). For 1 minute a nonhostile creature the hobgoblin sees within 30 ft. can add 1d4 to an attack or save if it hears and understands the command. Only one Leadership die can apply. Ends if the hobgoblin becomes Incapacitated.

Multiattack. Make three melee attacks or throw two Javelins. A Large or smaller creature hit by Shield Bash must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall Prone. Longsword uses the higher damage only in two-handed melee.

profiles.name: Hook Horror
profiles.appearance: A hulking creature with a hard shell, a vulture-like head and hooked forelimbs.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two Hook attacks. Darkvision 10 ft. and Blindsight 60 ft.; it loses Blindsight while Deafened. It has Advantage on hearing-based Perception checks.

profiles.name: Intellect Devourer
profiles.appearance: An exposed brain that scuttles on four clawed legs.

profiles.name: Jackalwere
profiles.appearance: A jackal that can pass as a human or take a jackal-headed hybrid form.

profiles.name: Kenku
tableNotes: It has advantage to attack a creature it surprised. Listeners can recognize an imitated sound with a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
profiles.appearance: A feathered, crowlike humanoid with a beak and no wings.

profiles.name: Kobold
tableNotes: In direct sunlight, it attacks and makes sight-based Perception checks at disadvantage. It has advantage to attack if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 feet of the target.

profiles.name: Kuo-toa
profiles.appearance: A fishlike humanoid with bulging eyes and rubbery skin.
tableNotes: Spear uses the higher damage only in two-handed melee. Net attacks at +3, range 5/15 ft., and Restrain one Large or smaller creature on a hit. An action and a successful DC 10 Strength check free the creature. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) destroys it and frees the target unharmed.

profiles.name: Kuo-toa Whip
profiles.appearance: A fishlike kuo-toa devotee that wields a long pincer staff.

profiles.name: Lemure
tableNotes: Magical darkness does not block its darkvision. If killed in the Nine Hells, it returns with full HP in 1d10 days unless the killing creature was good and used a blessed weapon, or its remains were sprinkled with holy water.
Resists cold; immune to fire and poison damage, and to the charmed, frightened, and poisoned conditions.

profiles.name: Lizardfolk Shaman
profiles.appearance: A reptilian humanoid. Its transformation takes the shape of a crocodile.
tableNotes: Bite uses the higher damage in crocodile form. In that form it also Grapples a Large or smaller creature on a hit (escape DC 12). The target is Restrained while the grapple lasts. The shaman cannot bite another target until it releases the grapple or returns to lizardfolk form.

profiles.name: Manes
profiles.appearance: A squat, bloated demon with claws and the remains of a humanoid shape.

profiles.name: Marid
profiles.appearance: A towering water genie with fishlike features.
tableNotes: Trident uses the higher piercing damage only in two-handed melee.

profiles.name: Mezzoloth
profiles.appearance: A stocky insectlike fiend armed with claws and a trident.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make one Claws and one Trident attack. Use the higher Trident damage only in two-clawed melee. Teleport can carry it and its gear 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it sees.

profiles.name: Mimic
tableNotes: An unmoving object form can pass for the real object. Touching it grips a Huge or smaller creature in a grapple (escape DC 13, with disadvantage on that check). While an enemy is stuck to it, the mimic has advantage on attacks against that enemy.
Its pseudopod can stick to the victim in object form. Its bite deals its listed piercing and extra acid damage.

profiles.name: Mind Flayer
profiles.appearance: A humanoid with a bulbous, octopus-like head and four tentacles around its mouth.

profiles.name: Monodrone
profiles.appearance: A spherical modron with one central eye and a pair of wings.
tableNotes: The 2014 Monster Manual errata gives Javelin +2 to hit and 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

profiles.name: Mud Mephit
profiles.appearance: A winged elemental made of mud that can pass for an ordinary mound when still.

profiles.name: Myconid Adult
profiles.appearance: A walking fungus with a broad mushroom cap and limbs.

profiles.name: Myconid Sovereign
profiles.appearance: A towering, broad-capped fungus that stands above the other myconids in its circle.

profiles.name: Needle Blight
profiles.appearance: A shambling plant creature covered with sharp conifer-like needles.

profiles.name: Nycaloth
profiles.appearance: A muscular, bat-winged fiend with clawed hands and a greataxe.
tableNotes: A creature hit by Claw makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On failure it takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage each time its turn starts. Further Claw hits increase that recurring damage by 5 (2d4). Magical healing or an action and a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check closes the wound.

profiles.name: Orc War Chief
profiles.appearance: An armored orc with a heavy greataxe and a spear.
tableNotes: The 2014 Monster Manual errata changes the average Greataxe damage to 15.
Spear deals 12 (1d6 + 1d8 + 4) piercing one-handed or when thrown. Two-handed melee deals 13 (2d8 + 4).

profiles.name: Orog
profiles.appearance: A heavily built orc in plate armor, armed with a greataxe and javelins.

profiles.name: Owlbear
tableNotes: Multiattack is one beak and one claw. Its sight- or smell-based Perception checks have advantage.

profiles.name: Pentadrone
profiles.appearance: A five-armed geometric modron with a star-shaped body.

profiles.name: Peryton
profiles.appearance: A predatory bird with a stag’s head and branching antlers. Its shadow can look humanoid.

profiles.name: Piercer
tableNotes: Drop onto one creature directly below with a +3 attack. A hit deals 1d6 piercing per 10 feet fallen, capped at 6d6. On a miss the piercer takes half its usual falling damage.

profiles.name: Pixie
tableNotes: It can become invisible by concentrating. Its innate Charisma spellcasting has DC 12. It uses druidcraft freely and can use confusion, dancing lights, detect evil and good, detect thoughts, dispel magic, entangle, fly, phantasmal force, polymorph, and sleep once per day each.

profiles.name: Quadrone
profiles.appearance: A cube-bodied modron with wings and four arms.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks or four Shortbow attacks.

profiles.name: Quaggoth
profiles.appearance: A long-armed, shaggy humanoid with pale fur and heavy claws.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. At 10 HP or fewer it has Advantage on attacks and its melee hits deal 7 (2d6) extra damage.
It is immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. The Monster Manual errata sets passive Perception at 11.

profiles.name: Red Slaad
profiles.appearance: A muscular red, toadlike creature with long claws.

profiles.name: Revenant
profiles.appearance: An animated humanoid corpse whose eyes betray the spirit’s burning determination.
tableNotes: Fist adds 14 (4d6) bludgeoning against its sworn target. Alternatively the revenant can use the hit to Grapple a Large or smaller creature instead of dealing damage (escape DC 14).

profiles.name: Roc
tableNotes: Multiattack is one beak plus one talon attack. Its talons grapple and restrain one creature (escape DC 19), and cannot grab a second while holding the first. Sight-based Perception checks have advantage.

profiles.name: Rug of Smothering
tableNotes: Smother uses +5 at 5 feet against a Medium or smaller creature. A hit grapples (escape DC 13), restrains, blinds, and blocks breathing. The target takes 2d6 + 3 bludgeoning at the start of its turns. Half the damage dealt to the rug is transferred to its captive.

profiles.name: Sahuagin Baron
profiles.appearance: A large, four-armed fishlike humanoid with fins, claws and rows of sharp teeth.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make one Bite and two attacks with Claws or Trident. Use the higher Trident damage only in two-handed melee. Blood Frenzy gives Advantage on melee attacks against injured creatures.

profiles.name: Sahuagin Priestess
profiles.appearance: An amphibious fishlike humanoid with a sharklike face and finned features.

profiles.name: Scarecrow
profiles.appearance: A straw-stuffed figure animated to stand guard or pursue intruders.

profiles.name: Sea Horse
tableNotes: It has no effective attack.

profiles.name: Shadow Demon
profiles.appearance: A flying demon with the insubstantial shape of a horned shadow.
tableNotes: If its Claws attack roll has Advantage, the hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage instead of the listed 10 (2d6 + 3).

profiles.name: Shield Guardian
tableNotes: Its Multiattack is two fists. With its amulet wearer within 60 feet, it takes half the damage the wearer would take. It also has a reaction to add 2 AC for the nearby wearer, regeneration, and a stored spell.

profiles.name: Shrieker
tableNotes: It has no attack. Bright light or movement within 30 feet starts a shriek audible out to 300 feet. It lasts until the disturbance is gone, then another 1d4 rounds.

profiles.name: Skeleton
tableNotes: Bludgeoning damage is doubled. Poison damage has no effect, and neither does the poisoned condition or exhaustion.

profiles.name: Slaad Tadpole
profiles.appearance: A tiny, clawed, toadlike larva that hatches after a red slaad’s egg gestates in its host.

profiles.name: Smoke Mephit
profiles.appearance: A small, winged elemental with a body made of smoke.

profiles.name: Spined Devil
profiles.appearance: A small winged devil with sharp spines along its tail.

profiles.name: Thri-kreen
profiles.appearance: A four-armed insectoid with mandibles, antennae and a color-changing carapace.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack. Bite also forces a DC 11 Constitution save. On failure the target is Poisoned for 1 minute. Failure by 5 or more also leaves it Paralyzed while poisoned this way. It can repeat the save at the end of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
Chameleon Carapace gives Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide. Standing Leap allows a 30 ft. long jump or 15 ft. high jump without a run-up.

profiles.name: Troglodyte
profiles.appearance: A cave-dwelling reptilian humanoid with a crest along its head and a strong stench.

profiles.name: Umber Hulk
profiles.appearance: A broad, armored burrower with insectlike eyes, heavy claws and powerful mandibles.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Mandibles attack.

Confusing Gaze. When a creature within 30 ft. starts its turn and can see its eyes, the hulk can force a DC 15 Charisma save unless the hulk is Incapacitated. On failure the creature loses reactions until its next turn. Roll a d8 for this turn: 1–4 do nothing, 5–6 use all movement in a random direction without an action, 7–8 make one melee attack against a random creature in reach, or do nothing if there is none.

A creature that is not Surprised can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid Confusing Gaze. It cannot see the hulk until the start of its next turn. Looking at the hulk sooner forces the save immediately.
Tunneler. It burrows through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a passage 5 ft. wide and 8 ft. high.

profiles.name: Vine Blight
profiles.appearance: A walking knot of tangled vines. When motionless it looks like a tangle of ordinary plants.

profiles.name: Water Weird
tableNotes: It is Invisible when wholly underwater. It dies if its bound water is destroyed or if it leaves that water.

A Medium or smaller creature hit by Constrict is Grappled (escape DC 13), pulled 5 ft. toward the weird and Restrained until freed. The weird tries to drown it and cannot constrict a second creature during the grapple.
profiles.appearance: A transparent, serpentine shape formed from water. It vanishes from sight when fully submerged.

attacks.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)

profiles.name: Winged Kobold
profiles.appearance: A small reptilian humanoid with batlike wings. Also called an urd.

profiles.name: Winter Wolf
tableNotes: The bite also knocks a creature prone on a failed DC 14 Strength save. Cold Breath, recharge 5–6: a 15-foot cone, DC 12 Dexterity, 4d8 cold or half on success. It has advantage on attacks when a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 feet of the target.

profiles.name: Wyvern
tableNotes: Multiattack is one bite and one stinger, with the claw available as described by its flying attack option. The stinger adds a DC 15 Constitution save against 7d6 poison, half on success.

profiles.name: Yochlol

damage.type: bludgeoning or piercing in spider form

habitats: Temples of Lolth on the Material Plane

profiles.appearance: In its demon form, a pillar of yellow slime with one eye and flailing tentacles. It can resemble a drow or a giant spider.
tableNotes: Multiattack. Make two melee attacks. Slam has 10 ft. reach in demon form. In spider form it becomes a piercing Bite. Each hit adds the listed poison damage.
Shapechanger. An action lets it become a drow, a giant spider or its demon form. Its game statistics stay the same, and its gear does not transform. It reverts on death.

Mist Form. An action changes it between its demon form and toxic mist along with its gear. In mist it is Incapacitated and speechless, flies 30 ft. with hover, passes through anything that is not airtight, has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, and is immune to nonmagical damage. It reverts on death.
A creature that starts its turn sharing the mist’s space makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On failure it is Poisoned and Incapacitated until the start of its next turn.
Innate magic uses Charisma (save DC 14) with no material components. At will · Detect Thoughts, Web. Once per day · Dominate Person.

profiles.name: Yuan-ti Abomination
profiles.appearance: A large serpent-bodied humanoid with scaled arms.

profiles.name: Yuan-ti Malison
tableNotes: Use the type-specific entry for attacks other than the snake-form bite.
profiles.appearance: A snake-human hybrid whose serpentine head, arms or lower body depend on its type.

profiles.name: Yuan-ti Pureblood
profiles.appearance: A mostly human-looking yuan-ti with subtle signs such as scales, slit eyes or a forked tongue.

profiles.name: Zombie
tableNotes: When damage would take the zombie to 0 HP, roll Constitution against DC 5 + damage taken. Success leaves it at 1 HP. Skip this roll for radiant damage or a critical hit.

variants.name: Arcanaloth (summoner variant)
adjustments: 40%: one arcanaloth.

variants.name: Balor (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 50%: 1d8 vrocks, 1d6 hezrous, 1d4 glabrezus, 1d3 nalfeshnees, 1d2 mariliths, or one goristro.

variants.name: Barbed Devil (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 30%: one barbed devil.

variants.name: Barlgura (summoner variant)
adjustments: 30%: one barlgura.

variants.name: Bearded Devil (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 30%: one bearded devil.

variants.name: Bone Devil (Polearm Variant)
variants.appearance: A skeletal, skull-faced devil with wings, a scorpion tail and a hooked polearm made of bone.

variants.name: Bone Devil (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 40%: 2d6 spined devils or one bone devil.

variants.name: Cave Bear
variants.appearance: A large, heavy-shouldered bear with coarse dark fur.

variants.name: Chasme (summoner variant)
adjustments: 30%: one chasme.

variants.name: Drider (variant)
adjustments: The published divine example retains its innate spells and adds 7th-level cleric spellcasting. Wisdom 16, save DC 14 and +6 to spell attacks.
At will · Poison Spray, Thaumaturgy.
1st (4 slots) · Bane, Detect Magic, Sanctuary.
2nd (3 slots) · Hold Person, Silence.
3rd (3 slots) · Clairvoyance, Dispel Magic.
4th (2 slots) · Divination, Freedom of Movement.
variants.appearance: A drow spellcaster’s upper body joined to the body of a giant spider.

variants.name: Erinyes (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 50%: 3d6 spined devils, 1d6 bearded devils, or one erinyes.

variants.name: Faerie Dragon (Older)
variants.appearance: A cat-sized dragon with butterfly wings. Older forms range from green through blue and indigo to violet.
adjustments: Superior Invisibility is a bonus action and requires Concentration. Worn and carried gear also becomes Invisible.

Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5–6) targets one creature within 5 ft. It must pass a DC 11 Wisdom save or lose reactions for 1 minute. At each turn start roll a d6. On 1–4 it takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement in a random direction. On 5–6 it stays still and can only repeat the save to end the effect.

variants.name: Giant Lizard (variant)
variants.appearance: A large, low-slung lizard with a scaly hide and clawed toes. Some can cling to ceilings or swim.

variants.name: Glabrezu (summoner variant)
adjustments: 30%: 1d3 vrocks, 1d2 hezrous, or one glabrezu.

variants.name: Gray Slaad (control gem variant)
variants.appearance: A gray, toadlike shapeshifter that can adopt a humanoid guise. Its control gem is hidden in its head.

variants.name: Hezrou (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 30%: 2d6 dretches or one hezrou.

variants.name: Horned Devil (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 30%: one horned devil.

variants.name: Ice Devil (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 60%: one ice devil.

variants.name: Kuo-toa Monitor
adjustments: Remove Spellcasting. Replace its action list with one bite and two unarmed strikes per Multiattack. An unarmed strike stops the target from taking reactions until the end of the monitor’s following turn.

variants.name: Marilith (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 50%: 1d6 vrocks, 1d4 hezrous, 1d3 glabrezus, 1d2 nalfeshnees, or one marilith.

variants.name: Mezzoloth (summoner variant)
adjustments: 30%: one mezzoloth.

variants.name: Mind Flayer Arcanist
adjustments: Add 10th-level Intelligence spellcasting, DC 15 and +7 to hit. Cantrips blade ward, dancing lights, mage hand, shocking grasp. Slots: 1st (4) detect magic, disguise self, shield, sleep; 2nd (3) blur, invisibility, ray of enfeeblement; 3rd (3) clairvoyance, lightning bolt, sending; 4th (3) confusion, hallucinatory terrain; 5th (2) telekinesis, wall of force.
variants.appearance: A robed aberration with an octopus-like head and four facial tentacles, trained in wizard magic.

variants.name: Nalfeshnee (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 50%: 1d4 vrocks, 1d3 hezrous, 1d2 glabrezus, or one nalfeshnee.

variants.name: Night Hag (Coven Variant)
variants.appearance: An old-looking fiend with purplish skin, long fingers and dark horns. A member of a three-hag coven.
adjustments: The standard coven spells use DC 15 and +7 to spell attacks for this hag. Her innate spells keep their own statistics.

variants.name: Nycaloth (summoner variant)
adjustments: 50%: 1d4 mezzoloths or one nycaloth.
variants.appearance: A muscular bat-winged fiend with claws and a heavy greataxe.

variants.name: Pit Fiend (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: Automatic: 2d4 bearded devils, 1d4 barbed devils, or one erinyes.

variants.name: Poltergeist
adjustments: The poltergeist is Invisible. Replace Life Drain with Forceful Slam and Telekinetic Thrust.

Telekinetic Thrust chooses a Medium or smaller creature, or an unattended object weighing no more than 150 lb., within 30 ft. The poltergeist contests its Charisma check against a creature’s Strength. If it wins, it hurls the creature up to 30 ft. in any direction. The creature takes 1d6 damage per 10 ft. moved if it encounters a hard surface or heavy object.
An unattended object can be hurled up to 30 ft. without a contest. It can hit one creature along its path with a ranged attack at +4 for 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage.
variants.appearance: An Invisible, incorporeal spirit. Its presence may be revealed by furniture or objects moving on their own.

variants.name: Psychic Gray Ooze
adjustments: Set Intelligence to 6. Add Psychic Crush, recharge 5–6. One sensed target within 60 feet attempts a DC 10 Intelligence save. It takes 3d6 psychic on failure, or half on success.
variants.appearance: A gray, liquid creature easily mistaken for wet stone. This variety can attack with its mind.

variants.name: Quaggoth Thonot
adjustments: Add innate Wisdom psionics at save DC 11. Use feather fall and invisible mage hand at will. Cure wounds, enlarge/reduce, heat metal, and mirror image are each usable once daily.
variants.appearance: A pale, shaggy cave humanoid with powerful arms and claws, distinguished by its psionic abilities.

variants.name: Satyr (Variant)
adjustments: Panpipes affect listeners within 60 feet on a failed DC 13 Wisdom save. Choose a one-minute charm, fright, or sleep. Creatures immune to charm and other satyrs are unaffected. Repeat saves at the end of turns. On a success or when the effect ends, the creature is immune to the pipes for 24 hours.

variants.name: Sea Hag (Coven Variant)
variants.appearance: An amphibious hag with a gaunt, hideous true face who can disguise herself with an illusion.
adjustments: The standard coven spells use DC 13 and +5 to spell attacks for this hag. Some published encounters may specify substitutions.

variants.name: Troll (variant)
variants.appearance: A lanky, long-nosed giant. Even separated limbs remain active while they can regenerate.

variants.name: Ultroloth (summoner variant)
adjustments: 50%: 1d6 mezzoloths, 1d4 nycaloths, or one ultroloth.
variants.appearance: A slender, gray-skinned fiend with an elongated head and two oval eyes in an otherwise blank face.

variants.name: Vampire Spellcaster
adjustments: Add 9th-level wizard spellcasting, save DC 15 and +7 to hit. Cantrips mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost. Slots: 1st (4) comprehend languages, fog cloud, sleep; 2nd (3) detect thoughts, gust of wind, mirror image; 3rd (3) animate dead, bestow curse, nondetection; 4th (3) blight, greater invisibility; 5th (1) dominate person.

variants.name: Vampire Warrior
adjustments: Wears plate. Its added sword Multiattack is two greatsword attacks.

variants.name: Vrock (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 30%: 2d4 dretches or one vrock.

variants.name: Yochlol (Summoner Variant)
adjustments: 50%: one yochlol.

variants.name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)
adjustments: In yuan-ti form, make two ranged or two melee attacks. Use the bite at most once per Multiattack.
variants.appearance: A humanoid body with a snake’s head.

variants.name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 2)
adjustments: In yuan-ti form, Multiattack is two bites with its snake arms.
variants.appearance: A humanoid whose arms end in snake heads instead of hands.

variants.name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 3)
adjustments: In yuan-ti form, make two ranged or two melee attacks. Use Constrict at most once per Multiattack. Constrict grapples and restrains on a hit (escape DC 13), one target at a time.
variants.appearance: A humanoid torso and arms above a long snake tail in place of legs.

rules.name: Alternate Familiar Forms
rules.appliesTo: Any spellcaster using find familiar at the DM’s discretion
adjustments: The DM can approve a Tiny creature outside the usual forms as a familiar. Pick its statistics explicitly. This option is separate from the optional bond of an imp, quasit, or pseudodragon.

rules.name: Bone Devil Polearm
adjustments: Multiattack makes one Hooked Polearm attack and one Sting instead of the usual Claw attacks.
A Huge or smaller creature hit by the polearm is Grappled (escape DC 14). The devil cannot use the polearm against another creature until the grapple ends.
On a Sting hit the target must also pass a DC 14 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the condition.

rules.name: Cave Bear
adjustments: Use the polar bear’s combat numbers, and add darkvision 60 feet.

rules.name: Demilich soul gems
adjustments: Acererak and demiliches following this practice use CR 21, or CR 23 in their lair. Add Trap Soul as an action.

Choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. DC 19 Charisma save. Success deals 7d6 necrotic, but a creature reduced to 0 hit points by it still has its soul trapped. Failure traps the soul and removes the creature’s body and equipment.
Crushing its gem releases the soul and restores the body nearby in its former condition. A soul held for 24 hours is consumed. The gems remain after the demilich is destroyed.

rules.name: Demon Summoning
adjustments: Once per day as an action, try to summon the creatures allowed for the particular demon. Roll the printed chance. The allies appear within 60 feet and remain until dismissed, killed, the summoner dies, or one minute passes. They cannot summon more allies.

rules.name: Devil Summoning
adjustments: Once per day, choose one of the listed devil reinforcements, then apply the chance specified for the summoner. Allies appear within 60 feet and remain for one minute, until killed or dismissed, or until the summoner dies. Summoned devils cannot summon in turn.

rules.name: Dracolich (template)
adjustments: Change the type to undead. Add resistance to necrotic damage and immunity to poison damage. Preserve the base dragon’s other damage defenses.
Add immunity to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions, and to exhaustion. Give it advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Use the dragon’s regular combat actions. The spirit can inhabit another dragon’s corpse if it is brought into contact with the gem on the same plane.

rules.name: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters
rules.appliesTo: Young, adult, or ancient true dragon
adjustments: Choose a number of spells equal to its Charisma modifier. Each is available once per day without material components.
Cap spell level at one-third of challenge rating, rounded down. Spell attack uses proficiency plus Charisma modifier, and save DC adds 8 to that sum.

rules.name: Drow Magic Armor and Weapons
adjustments: Recalculate armor class, attack, and damage using the actual bonuses of the equipment. For the example elite warrior, use AC 20 with shield and +2 armor, and increase attack and damage by 2 with its +2 sword.
Change encounter challenge if the altered numbers warrant it.

rules.name: Erinyes Rope
adjustments: An erinyes equipped with a rope of entanglement can send it after a creature within 20 feet. Use the magic item’s escape and break rules while the erinyes fights other targets.

rules.name: Ettercap Web Garrote
adjustments: Against a creature it can approach with advantage, use the garrote as a melee option: +4 to hit, reach 5 feet, 1d4 + 2 bludgeoning, plus grapple and inability to breathe or speak while held. Escape DC 12.

rules.name: Faerie Dragon Color and Age
adjustments: Age by color. Red up to 5 years, orange 6–10, yellow 11–20, green 21–30, blue 31–40, indigo 41–50, and violet 51 or more.

Each spell is usable once per day. Red gains Dancing Lights, Mage Hand and Minor Illusion. Orange adds Color Spray and yellow adds Mirror Image. Green adds Suggestion, blue Major Image, indigo Hallucinatory Terrain and violet Polymorph. Each color keeps all spells of younger colors.
Red through yellow are CR 1. Green through violet are CR 2. Innate spell save DC 13.

rules.name: Familiar Bond
adjustments: A willing familiar can end the bond. The master can use its senses within 1 mile.
For imp, quasit, and pseudodragon, the master shares Magic Resistance while within 10 feet. Use the usual base creature if it has no master.

rules.name: Genie Powers
adjustments: Possible disguise option is at-will disguise self. Stronger genies may have true polymorph one to three times daily, usually limited to themselves. Set duration and eligible targets before play.
Noble genies may grant one to three wishes to someone who is not a genie. Decide the limit and recovery interval for each genie.

rules.name: Giant Lizard Traits
adjustments: Choose either or both options. Hold Breath gives a 15-minute breath hold and swim speed 30 feet. Spider Climb allows difficult climbs and ceiling movement without checks.

rules.name: Giant Rat Disease
adjustments: A bite hit requires a DC 10 Constitution save. On failure, only magic can restore the victim’s hit points, and its maximum falls by 1d6 every 24 hours. It dies if the maximum reaches zero. Cure the disease to end the reduction.

rules.name: Hag Coven
rules.appliesTo: Three hags with all members within 30 feet of one another
adjustments: When all three coven members are within 30 ft. of one another, each casts with Intelligence as a 12th-level caster. The coven shares the spell slots. Each hag has save DC 12 plus her Intelligence modifier and spell attack bonus 4 plus that modifier.

Slots and spells by tier: 1st (4) identify, ray of sickness. 2nd (3) hold person, locate object. 3rd (3) bestow curse, counterspell, lightning bolt. 4th (3) phantasmal killer, polymorph. 5th (2) contact other plane, scrying. 6th (1) eyebite.

The three can create one hag eye in an uninterrupted hour. A hag can spend an action to see through it from the same plane. It has AC 10, 1 HP and Darkvision 60 ft. Destroying it deals 3d10 psychic damage to each member and Blinds them for 24 hours.

rules.name: Half-Dragon (template)
adjustments: Add blindsight to 10 feet, darkvision to 60 feet, Draconic, and the damage resistance corresponding to its dragon ancestry.
Borrow the matching dragon’s breath and recharge. Use wyrmling for Large or smaller, young for Huge, and adult for Gargantuan.
Use acid for black and copper, lightning for blue and bronze, fire for brass, gold, and red, poison for green, and cold for silver and white.
Use the matching breath’s numbers and reassess challenge if the new capabilities materially change the encounter.

rules.name: Ice Devil Spear
adjustments: The spear replaces the claws in Multiattack. Melee +10, 10-foot reach, 2d8 + 5 piercing plus 3d6 cold. On a failed DC 15 Constitution save, speed halves and the target cannot react. It can take an action or a bonus action on its turn, and cannot take both. Repeat the save at the end of turns for up to one minute.

rules.name: Incubus
adjustments: Use the shared fiend profile. The name and form do not change the statistics.

rules.name: Insect Swarm Subtypes
adjustments: Beetles add a 10-foot burrow speed. Centipedes can poison and paralyze a creature reduced to 0 hit points by their bites for one hour and leave it stable.
Spiders gain a 20-foot climb speed and web sensing, web walking, and wall climbing. Wasps walk 5 feet, fly 30 feet, and lose the climb speed.

rules.name: Loathsome Limbs
adjustments: On taking at least 15 slashing damage at once, roll a d20. On 1–10 nothing changes. On 11–14 it loses a leg, 15–18 an arm, or 19–20 its head, if that part remains. It dies from decapitation only if it cannot regenerate.
A separated part has AC 13, 10 HP and the troll’s Regeneration. It acts on the same initiative. A part left unattached dies when a replacement grows at the end of a short or long rest.
Each missing arm removes one Claw. A loose arm moves 5 ft. and makes one Claw with Disadvantage unless the troll sees both arm and target. A loose leg moves 5 ft. and cannot attack.
With its head detached the body loses Bite and is Blinded unless the head sees the body. The head cannot move and can Bite only within its own space.
Losing one leg halves the body’s speed. Losing both makes it Prone and crawling only. With one arm that crawl is at half speed. With neither arms nor legs it cannot move.

rules.name: Mephit Summoning
rules.appliesTo: Dust, Ice, Magma, Mud, Smoke, or Steam Mephit
adjustments: Once per day, roll 25%. On success summon 1d4 mephits of the same kind. They appear within 60 feet, cannot summon more allies, and remain for one minute at most.

rules.name: Nonhuman Lycanthropes
rules.appliesTo: Any of the five werecreature forms applied to a nonhuman humanoid
adjustments: Retain the original humanoid’s racial traits in humanoid form except where the curse replaces them. Apply the appropriate animal form, attack, ability, and damage changes.
Keep the creature’s own size and movement in its humanoid form unless the change specifically alters them.

rules.name: Rogue Modron
rules.appliesTo: Monodrone, Duodrone, Tridrone, Quadrone, or Pentadrone
adjustments: Use the chosen rank’s statistics. Remove Axiomatic Mind. Choose any alignment other than lawful neutral.

rules.name: Shadow Dragon (template)
adjustments: Add necrotic resistance and Stealth expertise if the dragon lacks it. Give it resistance to all damage except force, psychic, and radiant while it stays in dim light or darkness.
It can Hide as a bonus action in dim light or darkness. Sunlight imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Change any damaging breath and the extra damage of its bite to necrotic. A humanoid killed by the breath rises as a shadow controlled by the dragon.
Reassess challenge after applying the template.

rules.name: Slaad Control Gem
rules.appliesTo: Red, Blue, Green, Gray, or Death Slaad with a control gem
adjustments: A slaad created by a Spawning Stone has a control gem. A slaad that was born another way develops one on contact with the stone. Whoever holds the extracted gem can command the slaad, which is immune to being Charmed while under that control.

Wish can recover a gem, Imprisonment can transfer it on a failed save, and Greater Restoration destroys it harmlessly. A trained healer can spend 1 minute attempting extraction from an Incapacitated slaad with a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. On failure the slaad takes 4d10 psychic damage.

rules.name: Spore Servant (template)
rules.appliesTo: Flesh-and-blood creature of Large size or smaller
adjustments: Change the type to plant and alignment to unaligned. Keep armor class, hit points, Hit Dice, physical ability scores, and the original damage defenses.

Set Intelligence to 2, Wisdom to 6, and Charisma to 1. Decrease every movement speed by 10 feet to a minimum of 5 feet. Replace special senses with 30-foot blindsight and blindness outside that radius.

Remove the original saves, skills, languages, special traits, and action options other than ordinary physical melee attacks and Multiattack. Keep equipment damage when allowed. Add immunity to being blinded, charmed, frightened, or paralyzed.
With no usable melee attack, use an unarmed attack for 1d4 + Strength modifier bludgeoning, or 2d4 + Strength modifier for a Large body. It follows myconid orders conveyed by rapport spores.

rules.name: Thri-kreen Psionics
adjustments: Add 60-foot telepathy. Use Wisdom for innate casting. Use invisible mage hand at will, blur and magic weapon twice daily each, and invisibility on itself once daily.

rules.name: Thri-kreen Weapons
adjustments: With gythka and chatkcha, it can make two attacks of the same weapon type. Gythka uses +3 and 1d8 + 1 slashing at 5 feet. Chatkcha uses +4 and 1d6 + 2 slashing at 30/120 feet.

rules.name: Yuan-ti Malison Forms
adjustments: Transform between yuan-ti form and a Medium snake as an action. Equipment does not transform. Only the yuan-ti form uses its innate spells.
The yuan-ti form uses animal friendship on snakes at will and suggestion three times daily, DC 13. It has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Use the attack list attached to the selected body type.

rules.name: Yugoloth Summoning
adjustments: Once per day, roll the listed chance to summon the specified allies. They appear within 60 ft. and cannot summon in turn. They generally act independently except when summoned by an ultroloth. A summoned creature disappears after 1 minute, if it or its summoner dies, or if the summoner dismisses it as a bonus action.
